ValidationRule.description: DEPRECATED - When the Account Type is set as Partner, populate the partner account lookup field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Type , "Partner" ) , ISBLANK( NSP_Partner__c ) , NOT( OR( CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'System Admin' ) , $Profile.Name = "Data Migration" , $Profile.Name = "Sales Administrator" , $Profile.Name = "Integration User" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please populate partner Account when Type is Partner
